title: tau bug --json output
description: Schema for the single JSON object `tau bug [--json]` prints on stdout — the pre-filled GitHub issue carrying the redacted `tau doctor --report` diagnostics bundle. The command always exits 0 on a well-formed run (the diagnostics verdict lives inside the report, not the exit status). New keys may be added (additive); existing keys keep their names and types.

labels.description: Comma-separated issue labels (--labels, default "bug"; empty when --labels "" was passed).

url.description: github.com/javimosch/tau/issues/new link with title, labels, and body pre-filled. When the encoded link would exceed the size cap it falls back to a short body (see url_truncated).

body.description: Complete issue text — the --body description plus the diagnostics bundle (or an omission note). Always carries the full text even when url had to drop it.

report.description: The redacted Markdown diagnostics bundle as its own field (null under --no-report) — directly addressable without ungluing body.

report_source.description: Where the diagnostics bundle came from: "live" for a fresh `tau doctor` sweep, "attached" for an --attach-report file, null under --no-report.

url_truncated.description: true when the issue URL exceeded the pre-filled-URL size limit and carries the short fallback body instead of the full bundle.

out.description: Path the diagnostics bundle was written to (--out), or null.

opened.description: true when --open launched the issue URL in a browser and the opener exited 0.

done.description: Terminal marker — always true on this single emitted object (the same convention NDJSON streams use for their last line).

examples.title: Bug report
examples.body:
_Describe the bug here._

_No diagnostics attached (`tau bug --no-report`)._
